title: exotic-ccr-lean: Lean 4 Gate-0 certificates for the EXOTIC-CCR Jacobian counterexample anchor
description:
Historical exotic-ccr-lean v0.1.1 seed-release metadata. This is not release metadata for the later Theorem E freeze. The seed release records finite exact Gate-0 identities for the Jacobian anchor maps and standard non-injectivity packaging.

Later untagged theorem freeze: At commit a6bb091c05943cfcf35c405659e57df93ab8bb3d, ExoticCCR.theoremE proves that the canonical minimal X1 transport core is not essentially self-adjoint. Deficiency-index values and full A001 Theorem F remain historical paper-only results and are not Lean-covered. No result is claimed for arbitrary transport realizations, preferred extensions, extension counts, strong CCR/Weyl relations, C-star or CP results, channels, gates, physical significance, or computational advantage.

No release version is assigned to the theorem freeze, no tag points to its anchor commit, and no version DOI or Zenodo DOI exists for it. Independent Quantyra reimplementation; Apache-2.0.
